summary: Dragonheir introduced Peak Brawl Mode to Realm Arena. When a player reaches 1,200 points and enters the top 20 rankings, opponent identities and personal information are hidden during match selection. This update prevents players from target-farming specific opponents to pad their scores, revealing battle results only after the challenge is completed.
meta_changes: Peak Brawl Mode hides opponent details and player names for top 20 ranked players in Realm Arena to eliminate targeted point farming.
tips: Once reaching 1,200 points and top 20 rank in Realm Arena, expect hidden opponent identities until after matches finish.
title: 🚨 PEAK BRAWL IS HERE! New Realm Arena Gameplay! | Dragonheir: Silent Gods
